scope: Local ChatGPT device authorization to selected-model Standard scan; not a VPS release.
implementation: Authenticated SDK account inspector can select a compatible configured OpenAI model or create an account-only model configuration.
The chosen model and identity carry into New Scan; saving a configuration does not change the default model.
Required, revoked, missing, incompatible and unreadable identities block submission before queueing; no automatic API-key fallback.
SDK 0.5.0 has no public account model-list API; model ID is entered explicitly and availability is established by actual execution.

retryPolicy.note: Native request retries are permitted. No reconnect callback was observed in the successful scan; this is not a forced-disconnection retry test.

priorAttempt.cause: Local test snapshots and runtime outputs were inside the enclosing Axiom Git worktree; SDK rejected the output root.
priorAttempt.remedy: Move local runtime data outside the application repository; preserve paths and retry the frozen task. SDK path protection remains enabled.

localState.runtime: Persistent local application directory outside the Git worktree; credential files remain 0600.

limitations: This verifies one local ChatGPT account and model on a two-file synthetic project.
